name: quay_ask
description: Ask the operator one to four questions beside this terminal, when you need a decision or an answer before you go on. The call stays open for the answer, up to 100 seconds, and returns {"answers": [{"question", "chosen", "text"}]}, one for each question in order: the labels the operator picked, an empty list when they picked none, and what they wrote, left out when they wrote nothing. Nothing is picked for them, and every question has a text box of its own, so add no option for "other".

context.description: Why you ask, as Markdown, in at most 600 characters.

options.description: Two to six options. Left out, the operator answers in their own words.

label.description: At most 60 characters, and no other option's.

recommended.description: True on at most one option, marked as your pick.

multiple.description: True if the operator may pick several options, or send with none picked. Otherwise they pick one, or write instead.

name: quay_board
description: Show the operator how a long run stands, as a live line on this terminal's pane that opens into steps, progress and stats. Each call replaces the whole board, so send all of it each time. Returns {"shown": true} at once and sends nothing back. {"dismissed": true} means the operator closed this board: stop updating it, and use a new id for a later run.

title.description: What is running: plain text, at most 80 characters.

progress.description: For work that is counted. It drives the bar, which the steps do otherwise.

status.description: Left out, running. done and failed stop the clock; running after that starts a fresh one.

id.description: At most 40 characters. The same id is the same board, and its clock goes on. Left out, board.

name: quay_surface
description: Show the operator a surface you write yourself, as A2UI 1.0 messages, when no other tool shows what you need. quay_surface_guide has the components and the rules. One createSurface a call, and its surface whole in that call. With an action to you, the call stays open for it, up to 100 seconds, and returns the A2UI action message; without one it returns {"shown": true}.

place.description: Needed to create a surface. companion: narrow, beside the terminal, for something that needs an answer. tab: full width, opened by the operator, for long content. strip: compact, on the pane, for status, with no action to you.

title.description: Needed to create a surface: plain text, at most 80 characters.

name: quay_surface_read
description: Read where one of this terminal's surfaces stands, by the id a call returned. Use it for an answer you did not get, not to wait for one: the answer is typed into this terminal. Returns {"surface_id", "state", "result"}: state is shown, no_answer_yet, answered, dismissed, or ended when the terminal exited first, and result is there only when answered.
